notes: The light everything reads from one sun (simcore/light.hpp): the sun's elevation at the scenario's place, date and hour (simcore/solar.hpp, meeus_1998) against these thresholds. Day with the sun at low_sun_deg or higher; night more than twilight_deg below the horizon; dawn or dusk between, by whether it rises. The TV sight has daylight down to tv_min_elevation_deg; the battery is dark (lamp signals, the night march, the guns' optical sights blind, the waves' night factor) below optical_night_deg. twilight_deg must equal visual_range.json's (test_light.cpp).
source: derived: civil twilight's 6 degrees is the astronomical definition (meeus_1998); the others game values

twilight_deg.source: derived: civil twilight, the sun up to 6 degrees below the horizon (the astronomical definition)

low_sun_deg.source: game value: the sun this high or higher is full day; below it, the long shadows and glare of dawn or dusk

tv_min_elevation_deg.source: derived: the end of civil twilight (the astronomical definition), the light a daylight TV camera of the period still works in (simcore/solar.hpp's note)

optical_night_deg.source: derived: the end of civil twilight (the astronomical definition): below it the battery works by night (lamps, the night march, optical sights blind)
